minimap.label: MiniMap
minimap.summary: A small map in the corner shows where you are.

fast-warp.label: Fast Warp
fast-warp.summary: Warp rooms send you on your way much faster.

mist-gas-swap.label: Swap Power of Mist and Gas Cloud
mist-gas-swap.summary: Power of Mist and Gas Cloud trade places, which changes your route through the castle.

aggressive-enemy.label: Aggressive Enemy
aggressive-enemy.subtitle: Detection range increased
aggressive-enemy.summary: Enemies notice Alucard from much farther away.

karasuman.label: No Flinch Karasuman
karasuman.summary: Karasuman keeps coming no matter how hard you hit him.

slogra.label: No Flinch Slogra
slogra.summary: Slogra holds his ground when hit, so Gaibon can no longer carry him into their combo.

dopplegangers.label: No Flinch Dopplegangers
dopplegangers.summary: Both Doppelgangers fight straight through your hits.

succubus.label: No Flinch and Faster Succubus
succubus.summary: Succubus only flinches during her clone attack and fights faster.

richter-ai.label: Epic Richter AI
richter-ai.vanillaNote: On vanilla, some of the AI's subweapon hits use Richter's Cross damage.
richter-ai.summary: Richter's AI has been reworked, and it is much more amazing.

quick-items.label: Quick Items
quick-items.subtitle: L2 shortcut
quick-items.summary: Hold L2 and press a face button to use an item without opening the menu. Choose the items for the shortcut by equipping them in the equipment menu.

mp-items.label: MP Cost Items instead of consumables
mp-items.subtitle: Includes MP gating
mp-items.summary: Potions and other items are no longer used up; each use costs MP instead, and an item you cannot pay for cannot be used.
mp-items.valueTemplate: Costs: Potion {potion}, High Potion {high}, X-Potion {x}, Meal Ticket {meal}, Antivenom {cure}. Change them in the Stats Editor.

agunea-limit.label: Agunea Limit
agunea-limit.valueTemplate: Limit in this BIN: the first strike plus up to {extra} extra strikes.
agunea-limit.summary: Agunea's lightning chain has a limit, so it cannot run forever.

wolf-no-jump.label: No Jump Wolf Transformation
wolf-no-jump.summary: Turning into the Wolf no longer makes Alucard hop.

subweapon-weapon.label: Subweapon Attached to Weapon
subweapon-weapon.entityOnText: give Big Hearts instead of a subweapon
subweapon-weapon.summary: Every weapon you equip comes with a subweapon attached.

dark-stats.label: Dark Metamorphosis stat buff
dark-stats.valueTemplate: Bonuses: +{atk} ATK, +{def} DEF, +{str} STR, +{con} CON, +{int} INT, +{lck} LCK (ATK and DEF capped at {cap}).
dark-stats.summary: Dark Metamorphosis, the buff potions and the Faerie's buffs raise Alucard's stats based on his base stats.

dark-speed.label: Dark Metamorphosis SpeedUp
dark-speed.valueTemplate: Speed in this BIN: {mult}× while active.
dark-speed.summary: Dark Metamorphosis makes Alucard faster on his feet.

sky-walker.label: Sky Walker
sky-walker.summary: The Leap Stone becomes Sky Walker: jump in midair as often as you like, and press Down + X at any time to dropkick.
sky-walker.vanillaNote: On vanilla the dropkick stays on Up + Triangle.

heal-hearts.label: Healing items use Hearts instead of MP
heal-hearts.subtitle: Requires MP Cost Items instead of consumables
heal-hearts.summary: Healing items cost hearts instead of MP, from the menu and from the L2 shortcut.
heal-hearts.valueTemplate: Costs: Potion {potion}, High Potion {high}, X-Potion {x}, Meal Ticket {meal}.
heal-hearts.vanillaNote: The heart costs are sized for ASS; on vanilla, lower them in the Stats Editor.

subweapon-mp.label: Subweapon use MP instead of Hearts
subweapon-mp.summary: Alucard's subweapons spend MP instead of hearts.

faerie-behavior.label: Faerie Behavior
faerie-behavior.subtitle: Free items and buffs
faerie-behavior.summary: The Faerie stops using up your items and casts buffs when you get hit.
faerie-behavior.valueTemplate: Hammer, Uncurse and Antivenom: {mp} MP per use.

holy-water-richter.label: Richter-style Holy Water
holy-water-richter.subtitle: Traveling flames
holy-water-richter.summary: Holy Water flies in Richter's arc, and its fire races along the floor.

richter-save.label: Richter always saved
richter-save.summary: You can save Richter after you get the Holy Glasses, but you still need to fight and defeat him.

damage-colors.label: Damage Number Colors
damage-colors.summary: Damage numbers show at a glance when you hit a weakness or a resistance.

instant-food.label: Instant Food
instant-food.summary: Food heals the moment you use it, and the Meal Ticket serves up a random dish.

eat-food-on-pickup.label: Eat Food on Pickup
eat-food-on-pickup.summary: Food you find is eaten on the spot.

hint-items-no-attack.label: Hint Items
hint-items-no-attack.summary: Some foods and medicines become Hint items, and Hint items carry no attack, shown or dealt.

stopwatch-rework.label: Stopwatch slows bosses
stopwatch-rework.summary: The Stopwatch's freeze is shorter, but bosses that used to ignore it are now slowed by it.

all-cloaks-hearts.label: All Cloaks give Hearts
all-cloaks-hearts.summary: Every cloak turns the damage you survive into hearts.

heart-regen.label: Heart Regeneration
heart-regen.summary: Hearts slowly come back on their own, faster with more CON.
